# DEGREE 15, DIAMETER 3: 1,620 VERTICES
# -------------------------------------
# 1,620 vertices, 12,150 undirected edges, every vertex of degree 15, every pair of vertices within 3
# steps of each other.
#
# Route-chart lift: the controller is the Z_20-lift of a 3-vertex Schreier base (60 vertices, symbols
# a, b, their inverses and the self-inverse s), the cell F_3^3; (v, x) is joined to (w, M x + lambda
# d) for every dart v -> w with its own chart (M, d) and lambda in F_3 (charts in construction.json).
#
# Vertex 27 v + x0 + 3 x1 + 9 x2 is the pair (v, x), v = 20 c + g the controller vertex (c, g).
#
# One edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered 0..1619; README.md describes the construction.

# symbol a, per-dart charts: (v, x) -- (a(v), M x + lambda d) (the same edges as a^-1)
